  • Constructor Details

    • MarineCorps

      public MarineCorps(String corpsName, String baseLocation, String corpsCommander, int opFunds)
      CONSTRUCTOR Purpose: Creates a new corps with a generated ID.
      Parameters:
      corpsName - falls back to "Unnamed Corps" if null/blank
      baseLocation - falls back to "Unknown Base Location" if null/blank
      corpsCommander - falls back to "Unknown Commander" if null/blank
      opFunds - falls back to 0 if negative
